g.text: A seeded data-efficiency diagnostic for quantum feature modulation
Lines: three-seed arithmetic means. Dots: every optimizer seed. Bands: seed range.
Exact Gram MSE: 1.10e-32 / 7.86e-33; clipped at 1e-14 for readability. 64-state points reuse verified recorded runs.
All sizes additionally use 96 validation pairs; training-pair counts exclude validation.
One nested state sequence; exact expectations; no finite-shot or general quantum-superiority claim.
